cards.stem: What interval does the page give for electing a president?
cards.quote: An election for president of the United States happens every four years on the first Tuesday after the first Monday in November.
cards.hint: Focus on the frequency stated at the start of the section.

cards.stem: What date is given for the next presidential election?
cards.quote: The next presidential election is scheduled to be on November 7, 2028.
cards.hint: Look for the scheduled date in November.

cards.stem: Which agency handles candidate registration to run for president?
cards.quote: Candidates register with the Federal Election Commission to run for president.
cards.hint: Recall where candidates file to run.

cards.stem: Which group casts votes for president in December?
cards.quote: Electors cast their votes for president in the Electoral College.
cards.hint: Check who votes in December before Congress counts.
